findings.passage: "It is imperative that power must be restored back to the people and enable them to make the decision on issues such as how elections should be conducted in Pennsylvania and how their tax dollars should be spent," Gaydos said.
findings.note: House caucus press release on her vote for Senate Bill 106, whose first proposed constitutional amendment would require all voters to show valid ID each time they vote, by mail or in person. The release text describing the measure is the caucus's; the quoted sentence is hers.

findings.passage: Senate Bill 106 simply gives voters a chance to vote on additional issues. I trust our voters who are perfectly able to decide on these important topics.
findings.note: Closing quote in the same release, framing the ID amendment and others as questions for voters to decide.

findings.passage: We can all agree that the election process must be held to the highest integrity. And that no legal voter should ever be denied the opportunity to cast a legal ballot.
findings.note: Her quote on House Bill 1300 (Voting Rights Protection Act), which the release says would expand the voter ID law, with scannable voter registration cards to be used when voting in person, plus audits, signature checks on mail ballots and better voter lists.

findings.passage: While I believe that the use of absentee ballots and the paper ballot option for people who are unable to get to the polls is perfectly safe, fewer steps in the process means fewer errors.  I am a strong advocate for voting at the polls on Election Day, if able, as the best, most efficient way to move toward greater election integrity.
findings.note: Statement on House Resolution 1032 (select committee on election integrity), which she said she would vote against as written. Speaks to absentee ballots and voting in person.
subjects: absentee and mail ballots versus voting in person

findings.passage: The establishment of a bipartisan investigatory committee with subpoena power will enable members to gather the facts and work toward making sure our election process is sound and secure.
findings.note: Statement joining colleagues who asked to delay certification of the 2020 results until an audit was done; mentions constituent concerns about the mail-in ballot system.
